record.description: Default review reads omit terminal records, retain superseded records, and carry compact current outcomes. Detailed decisions and comments load only for an opened record.

source_refs.clause: Review totals and record-detail trial evidence

record.statement: The review page and CLI list, document, and search reads omit archived Requirements, Rules, Questions, and Topics and abandoned Resolutions by default. API callers select this behavior with `exclude_terminal`. Superseded records stay visible.
